description:
Initialize a direct multipart S3 upload for a book scan up to 500 MiB (PDF or ZIP of page scans).

Returns key, upload_id, part_size (16 MiB) and presigned PUT part_urls. Upload each slice via HTTP PUT, collect
its ETag response header in order, and finish with complete_book_upload before calling create_book. For scans up
to 100 MiB that already have a public HTTPS URL, pass file_url directly to create_book instead.

mime.description: MIME type: application/pdf, application/zip or application/x-zip-compressed.
mime.title: Mime

name.description: Original file name, e.g. scan-1840.pdf or pages.zip.
name.title: Name

size_bytes.description: Exact file size in bytes (up to 500 MiB).
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

name: create_book_upload
